patch_description: Redesigned the program with a novel object-oriented architecture, decoupling the optimization logic into an explicit `AdamOptimizer` and a `PathEnergyModel`. The new formulation calculates physically-motivated, precise gradients (using true curve len/rubber-banding and smoothness stiffness). Instead of only a local force, the base attraction now exerts a global steady pull to guide the entire flight path into a sweeping curve toward the base station, avoiding sharp V-shape length penalties (F1) while substantially decreasing the base signal drop (F3).
